newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia share trade slows, Farma gains on result.
newsitem.headline: Estonia share trade slows, Farma gains on result.

text.p: Drugs maker Tallinna Farmaatsiatehas gained on Friday after it reported its first quarter results, but market trade was modest with other shares gaining only slightly, dealers said.
Trade on the bourse was 41.2 million kroons versus more than 60 million kroons the day before. The Talse index gained 0.49 percent to close on 248.83.
Tallinna Farmaatsiatehas gained 5.6 percent to 123.50 kroons after its first quarter results, which showed a rise in net profit to 11.19 million kroons versus 7.4 million kroons.
Its share turnover was 3.8 million kroons.
"The results were good for the first quarter and they are usually even better at the end of the year," a dealer said.
"Farmaatsiatehas has exceeded its profit estimate by a quarter and it might exceed its annual forecast," he added.
"The company is strong and is growing rapidly and its results cannot get worse," he said.
Forekspank was the most active stock and turned over 6.4 million kroons to gain by 1.65 to 184.10 kroons.
Hansapank stayed stable at 253 kroons with a turnover of 6.1 million kroons.
"Hansapank is supported by the stock dividends decision to be taken at the coming shareholders' meeting, which makes the price more attractive," another dealer said.
Hansapank is to issue one new share for every share held to double its share capital to 382.5 million kroons.
On the free market, Eesti Naitused (Estonian Fairs) fell by three percent to 82 kroons, Rakvere by 1.3 percent to 15.85 kroons and Norma by one percent to 74.75 kroons.
Dealers said the market may be more active next week.
"Share prices might do an upward correction in the middle of next week, when shareholders meetings are over and investors have got some additional information," a dealer said.
"The trends will be determined on Monday," another dealer said. "If the decrease continues on Monday, investors will be afraid and some further selling will be seen."
Market capitalisation on Friday increased slightly to 13.6 billion kroons from 13.5 billion kroons on Thursday.
